lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap for New Caledonia using the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset includes approximately 97% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with attributes including building type, construction materials, address information, and OSM metadata. Data currency averages 5 years with recent updates within the last 3 months.
